messages:
anya: quick sync on manifest refactor idea: split core (stable contract) + per-mode extension sections. avoids ad-hoc hosted-only keys.

matt: high-level thumbs up. main worry: migration complexity for adapters and runtime agents.

anya: plan is incremental: accept both shapes for a window, add lint/converter, and do a single-adapter pilot.

reza: can we standardize a small capability vocabulary first? planner can't keep parsing random fields.

olivia: agreed. propose a registry with canonical names + semantic version per capability (eg streaming:v1). infra can host.

infra-bot: ACTION logged: INFRA-4210 "capability registry api" created.

cheng: secret handling: core should only reference secret ids. extension declares expected secret class (kms|token|none). runtime resolves. keeps control plane safe.

sam: routing/fallbacks: don't bake fallback policies into extensions. core should allow a policy reference that the router evaluates. e.g. `fallbacks: [ {when: "cap_missing", policy: "policy://lowcost"} ]`

matt: nice. then planner/routing can consult registry+runtime probes to decide. also add a fast discovery endpoint on adapters that returns actual live capabilities (cacheable).

anya: probe idea: GET /adapter/_probe -> { capabilities: ["streaming:v1"], runtime: "rt-3" } — short ttl. planner uses this first, falls back to manifest if probe fails.

reza: tests: add shadow mode where planner reads extensions but still acts on old manifest logic until we flip. helps catch policy mismatches.

olivia: schema ownership: core team owns core schema; mode teams own their extension schema and versioning. also enforce that extensions never override core keys.

cheng: operations: migration checklist should include: secret review, telemetry mapping, and a rollout for console rendering so UI doesn't break.

anya: i'll write RFC with examples, probe API, registry contract, and migration steps. will call out the lint tool `manifest-check` and conversion helpers.

matt: one more: ensure adapters keep backward-compatible adapter API during transition (adapter HTTP endpoint payload stayed same).

anya: yep. target RFC post in #architecture-rfcs tomorrow. :+1:

infra-bot: NOTE: INFRA-4210 linked to INFRA-4123 for registry integration.

sam: thanks all, this should cut a lot of edge-case logic out of planner.

anya: cool, i'll DM owners for volunteer pilot adapter.
